task: Prepare the production deployment contract for the ED-Finder V3 Svelte hard cut on the existing isolated branch migration/svelte-deployment-contract. This is repository implementation work only: do not deploy, access production systems, read production secrets, alter DNS, databases or live data. Read CLAUDE.md, the V3 application-stack decision, root README/CHANGES, all deployment and recovery docs, Dockerfiles, compose files, nginx/static-server configuration, GitHub Actions workflows, Octopus/ops hooks and the current React and apps/web build contracts. Replace or extend that path so the final single frontend is the pinned Node 24/SvelteKit adapter-static build from apps/web, served through the production-representative deep-route/static/proxy contract being implemented on migration/svelte-platform-contracts. Add focused tests for image contents and runtime route ownership. Preserve existing backend, worker and database containers. Run all relevant syntax, build, container, nginx/server, unit and contract checks locally; do not suppress warnings. Leave a small independently reviewable branch that migration/svelte-full-cutover can merge after its application work, and finish with exact files changed, validation commands, remaining external promotion/approval gates and a rollback procedure.
